about: The mutant ledger of internal/gofacts, the reviewed table of vouched foreign facts and their guards (LAWFFI LF2; interop.md, Foreign facts 7). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/gofacts.

mutants.name: ffi-vouch-without-reason
mutants.from: Reason: "its body is bytealg.IndexByte, assembly that only loads from b"
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: every vouched row says why the reviewer holds it.

mutants.name: ffi-vouch-stale-source
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a row holds the hash of its function's declaration at the pinned toolchain; another hash is reviewed again.

mutants.name: ffi-guard-blind
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a guard refutes a row whose function leaves its operand changed.

mutants.name: ffi-fresh-guard-blind
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a fresh row's guard refutes a result that shares memory Go keeps (regexp.Regexp.SubexpNames).

mutants.name: ffi-sync-row-unguarded
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: every row of v1.GoSyncCallbacks has a guarded call.

mutants.name: ffi-sync-guard-goroutine-blind
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: the sync guard refutes a callback run on another goroutine.

mutants.name: ffi-sync-guard-one-call
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: the sync guard calls twice, so a callback kept for a later call is refuted.

mutants.name: ffi-pure-guard-one-state
mutants.to:
for i, s := range []ambient{a, a} {
		_ = b
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: the pure guard compares calls under two host states (filepath.Abs reads the working directory).

mutants.name: ffi-pure-except-dropped
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: the guarded members of v1.PureImports are regenerated when the table changes.

mutants.name: ffi-sync-unguarded-acts
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a sync row acts only on its current validated guard line.

mutants.name: ffi-sync-refuted-acts
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a refuted guard line is named as a refutation.

mutants.name: ffi-host-stale-acts
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a guard line whose digest or toolchain differs is stale and does not act.

mutants.name: ffi-pure-unguarded-acts
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: ergo bind go writes the pure tier only for a package whose guard line acts.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-pure
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): a memory-only call is not pure: it is opaque in a footprint.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-unguarded-acts
mutants.from:
case !ok:
		h.c.errorf(fn.Decl.Name, CodeType, "%s is bound as memory-only without
mutants.to:

mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): a memory-only binding checks only on its row's current validated guard line.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-refuted-acts
mutants.from:
case refuted:
		h.c.errorf(fn.Decl.Name, CodeType, "%s is bound as memory-only, and
mutants.to:
case refuted && false:
		h.c.errorf(fn.Decl.Name, CodeType, "%s is bound as memory-only, and
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): a refuted guard line is named as a refutation.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-bind-unguarded
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): ergo bind go writes a memory-only row only on its guard line current and validated.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-guard-one-state
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): the memory-only guard runs each row under two host states.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-row-unguarded
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): every memory-only row has a guarded call.

mutants.name: ffi-effect-stale-source
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, memory-only (GBX6): a memory-only row holds its declaration's hash; another hash is reviewed again.

mutants.name: ffi-sync-visitall-order
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 7: a sync guard's verdict depends on no other guard having run (LF2d: flag.VisitAll flipped between stdlaws runs).

mutants.name: ffi-host-guard-one-state
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, host rows (HOST-ROW): a host row's guard runs its call under both host states.

mutants.name: ffi-host-guard-shared-result
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, host rows (HOST-ROW): Environ's guard writes its result, so a shared result is refuted.

mutants.name: ffi-host-guard-goroutine-blind
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, host rows (HOST-ROW): a host call that leaves a goroutine is refuted.

mutants.name: ffi-host-file-state-blind
mutants.from: func stateText(s ambient) []byte { return []byte("fixture of HOME=" + s.home + " TZ=" + s.tz + "\n") }
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, file rows (HOST-ROW-2): each host state's fixtures differ, so a file call that keeps another state's file is refuted.

mutants.name: ffi-host-file-guards-unregistered
mutants.rule: interop.md Purity and authority, file rows (HOST-ROW-2): every file row has a guarded call.

mutants.name: hostfs-stat-lstats
mutants.rule: hostfs.Stat's row (it follows a symbolic link) holds by its guard: the stat of a link is its target's.

mutants.name: hostfs-guards-unregistered
mutants.rule: Every host row, hostfs's included, has a guarded call.

mutants.name: effect-time-reads-zone
mutants.rule: HOST-ROW-3b: a time.Time row's guard draws times in time.Local, so a method that reads the zone (Hour, Year) is refuted under the two host states' TZ.

mutants.name: effect-time-state-zoned
mutants.from: return effectRun{[2]int64{t.UnixNano(), u.UnixNano()}, func() []any { return []any{f(t, u)} }}
mutants.to: return effectRun{fmt.Sprint(t, u), func() []any { return []any{f(t, u)} }}
mutants.rule: HOST-ROW-3b: a time is compared by its instant, never printed in time.Local's zone, which the two host states differ in.
